title: Electric Vehicle Conductive Charging System — Part 1: General Requirements
qco_name: Electric Vehicles and Charging Stations (Quality Control) Order
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Ministry of Heavy Industries

clauses.title: EV Charging Operational Modes (Mode 1 to Mode 4)
clauses.text: Clause 6.1: Specifies 4 EV charging modes: Mode 1 (non-dedicated domestic socket max 16A, prohibited in public), Mode 2 (domestic socket with In-Cable Control and Protection Device - ICCPD max 32A), Mode 3 (dedicated AC EV supply equipment - EVSE with pilot wire handshake), and Mode 4 (fast DC off-board charger with bidirectional CAN communication).

clauses.title: Electrical Shock Protection and Residual Current Device (RCD)
clauses.text: Clause 8.4: All public and domestic EV charging points must incorporate Type B or Type A RCD with 6 mA smooth DC fault detection to disconnect power in less than 40 milliseconds upon detection of earth leakage currents.
